dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple closed-loop 'O' shapes with high-contrast light perimeters against a dark base coat. The geometry features a sharp gradient transition from the dark exterior to light interior rings, particularly prominent in the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, high-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients, concentrated primarily in the cranial-dorsal area and along the mid-lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest 'O' structures in the upper-mid dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle, with an associated linear alignment of smaller high-intensity blobs extending toward the lower lateral boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: A unique conjoined dual-annuli structure forming a distinct 'figure-8' pattern is visible near the upper-central dorsal midline.
